title: Full Stack Developer - Urban Data Platform
description: UrbanTech builds data platforms for smart cities. We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to work on our urban analytics dashboard. Frontend: React, TypeScript, Mapbox GL JS. Backend: Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Redis. Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS. You will build interactive visualizations for urban mobility, air quality, and energy consumption data. Required: 3+ years full stack, React + Python, PostGIS experience a plus.

screening.summary: Good full-stack match with mapping focus (Mapbox/PostGIS), smart city domain, modern tech stack.

ranking.thinking_trace: Strong full-stack + mapping tech match (React, Mapbox, PostGIS, FastAPI, K8s), smart city domain alignment.
